Sound system

Linear crossover / cabinet response

Active crossover/cabinet filters and the small-signal driver circuit when enabled, summed with polarity and alignment. Nonlinear drive, excursion compression, heating and room are excluded from this curve.

Room / observation

Stack and room settings are configurable models. Meters show digital dBFS. No calibrated acoustic SPL or measured cabinet fidelity is claimed.

Dubplate Arena

Activate audio, then Roll Out. The source rack controls individual engines; the bus desk controls musical groups. Select a channel to inspect EQ, routing and sends. The return rack stays independent of source cuts.

Open Engine Room for original Kinetic, Sabre and SIGNAL editors, or Mosaic and Atmos parameters. These share the Arena clock and audio context. Four Sabre assets can also be sliced and triggered directly from Arena events.

Store a version with Shift-click on a scene; recall normally at the next bar. Export System includes source audio and engine settings. Stack profiles describe the supplied four-way configuration; tune the crossover, alignment, band gain and colour to your system.

Tape and spring processing are algorithmic interpretations. Atmos parallel processing includes its original dry/processed balance. Use the HTTPS site for AudioWorklet; compatibility mode uses the original buffered rendering approach.
